The '''Fortis Cothon''' is a large harbour on the north side of [[Civitas illa Fortis]]. Players who sail to Fortis via [[charter ship]] will arrive here.

During the [[Twilight's Promise]] quest, the player must travel to the Fortis Cothon to speak with Nel, a Knight of Varlamore.  

If you have completed the quest [[Children of the Sun]] you can travel there by talking with [[Regulus Cento]]. He can be found outside Varrock's east gate.

Players may dock their own boats here at level 38 Sailing.

==Trivia==
* {{Wp|Cothon}}s are Phoenician ports that were used by states such as {{Wp|Ancient Carthage|Carthage}}. This can generally be attributed to the fact that Varlamore was in part inspired by Roman aesthetics.
